material_confirmations.subject: Expired-content validity extension versus independent reapproval
material_confirmations.quote: Reapproval or an explicitly authorized validity extension must be completed before the document becomes AI eligible again.
material_confirmations.prior_boundary: Q2 non-submitter reviewer explicit approval; Q3 formal independent re-review alone resets 180-day clock; no overdue/validity/authorization bypass
material_confirmations.parent_confirmation: Confirm a validity extension cannot substitute for required eligible tenant non-submitter Knowledge Reviewer approval/formal re-review, reset the 180-day clock by itself, or bypass any current eligibility restriction; if a new route is intended, explicitly define its authority and scope.

material_confirmations.subject: Legal retention exception and approved-deletion retrieval exclusion
material_confirmations.quote: Legally retained content must remain excluded from AI retrieval unless separately and legitimately authorized.
material_confirmations.prior_boundary: Q5 deletion_scope/purge_clock/backup restore require approval-triggered exclusion; failed purge/retention never restores eligibility
material_confirmations.parent_confirmation: Confirm legal hold/retention authority cannot return deletion-approved content to AI retrieval/citation or reinstate it; define whether the quoted exception applies only to otherwise eligible content outside approved deletion, or explicitly identify any intended change.

material_confirmations.subject: Legal hold release and 24-hour purge deadline
material_confirmations.quote: Applicable legal and regulatory retention requirements must take precedence over ordinary deletion schedules.
material_confirmations.prior_boundary: Approval timestamp starts mandatory 24-hour clock; documented narrow legal hold can prohibit physical purge; no reset is permitted through restoration
material_confirmations.parent_confirmation: When an authorized legal hold blocks physical purge, how is the original deadline/hold status recorded, and what exact deadline and start event govern purge after hold release? Specify authority/evidence; do not infer pause, reset or extension.

material_confirmations.subject: Deferred failed/rejected retention versus existing draft purge obligation
material_confirmations.quote: The exact automatic retention and deletion periods for failed, rejected, superseded, expired, and overdue content are explicitly deferred.
material_confirmations.prior_boundary: Actual Analysis describes draft FR-KB obligation: purge failed/rejected uploads and derived content within 24 hours; Q5 also says rejection does not automatically trigger physical deletion.
material_confirmations.parent_confirmation: Confirm whether the Q5 failed/rejected retention deferral and non-automatic rejection deletion intentionally replace the draft failed/rejected 24-hour purge obligation, or whether that obligation remains. Exact lifecycle durations remain pending; no indefinite retention or silent waiver inferred.
